text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aah, that was refreshing.
Turned out to be 
a great morning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship made an incomprehensible remark 
the other day.
I ran up to her to ask what 
she had meant by it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Haaahn?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship gave it her all today. With 
running like that,
she would have held her 
own in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, too.
choice_data_list: Why is this the last race of the y...
Why is this the last race of the year?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! You really get it, don't you?
choice_data_list: The real thing starts now, doesn't it?
The real thing starts now, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Because the real deal starts now.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And today,
<chrname>'s unique running clashed with 
the great Golshi's full-power running.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Which one got you more excited?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Golshi-chan's with you on that one!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: See yaaa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone's 'Representative Exchange 
Race' had concluded.
At Mei Satake's call, 
the project participants lined up in 
formation.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I will now announce the members 
representing Japan for the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "In no particular order. --...First up."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: <chrname>！

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I exchange looks with <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her, the names of the other 
members were called out one after
another. 
Among them was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—As expected,
Gold Ship wasn't included in 
the rankings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Has Gold Ship walked away from
'Project 
L'Arc'?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though she wasn't my trainee, and 
even though she was utterly bizarre, her 
sheer audacity born of that eccentricity 
was truly magnificent.
choice_data_list: (I wanted to keep working hard tog...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Channeling the unbearable frustration
into 
a fist, she strikes the tree trunk.
choice_data_list: (I wanted to keep working hard tog...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! Don't go calling me right in the 
middle of brainstorming! Sheesh~!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And here I was, willing to support you 
bastards in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
from now on.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"That's why you turned down the national 
team selection in the first place, isn't 
it?!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"The overseas campaign starts now, right? 
And your running style's gonna reach 
perfection from here on out, isn't it?!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My heart is having a total 
thumping-rendezvous right now, you know?! 
Do you get it?! What this means!!??

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It means you guys and me are gonna go win 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe in the 
craziest way possible!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If you pull any boring crap on me, I'll 
wash out your eyeballs! In hell!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Brace yourself☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"During the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
expedition,
Gold Ship will apparently pour 
her heart and soul into supporting
<chrname>."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...She was dedicating her precious time 
to this, and I wanted to live up to her 
expectations. That was what I thought to 
myself."
